name: orchestrator
description: Autonomous multi-model orchestration for Claude Code: routes work to Haiku, Sonnet, Opus or Fable by task complexity, runs a plan-build-verify-review pipeline, enforces a model cost cap, and flags Claude Code releases and docs changes that need review.

routing_mode.title: Routing mode
routing_mode.description: How strongly work is routed to the orchestrator's agents. steer (default): generic built-in agent calls are redirected to ours once per prompt. strict: they are always refused unless you name the agent. guide: advice only. off: no routing.

max_tier.title: Highest model tier
max_tier.description: The most capable model subagents may run on: haiku, sonnet, opus or fable. Spawns above it are refused with a suggestion to use a cheaper agent. Anything else means no cap.

update_check.title: Check for Claude Code updates
update_check.description: Once a day, fetch the Claude Code changelog and docs index from code.claude.com and mention changes that affect this plugin.

verify_gate.title: Quality gates before finishing
verify_gate.description: Ask Claude once, before it finishes a turn, to (1) run the verifier when code changed and no test, lint or build ran afterwards, and (2) get a stronger agent's check when a hard request was answered by a weaker session model alone.
